data_note: Initial local job dataset with 14 Bangladesh job leads and 12 independently checked worldwide listings (reviewed 7 Nov 2026); publication dates are not proof vacancies are still open. Automatic feeds supplement these records when accessible.

jobs.title: Incident Responder
jobs.description: Incident response and digital forensics role for Bengal InfoSec, the cybersecurity unit of Bengal Airlift Group, involving cross-source log investigation and incident case management.
responsibilities: Correlate SIEM, endpoint and network evidence to investigate potential incidents.
Document indicators, artifacts, case updates and response outcomes.
Coordinate incident workflows and produce response summaries.
requirements: Bachelor degree in CSE, IT, cybersecurity or related area.
At least three years of relevant monitoring or incident response experience.
BTL2 or CCDL2 training certification listed as a requirement.

jobs.title: Penetration Tester
jobs.description: Remote volunteer position testing a privacy-focused encrypted messaging product across web applications, APIs, authentication and security architecture. This is explicitly a volunteer opportunity, not a paid job.
responsibilities: Plan and execute authorized web, API and authentication security tests.
Validate vulnerabilities and work with developers on remediation.
Review threat models and relevant cryptographic design issues.
requirements: Hands-on application/API security testing and common penetration-testing tools.
Familiarity with secure communications, threat modeling and cryptographic concepts.
Ability to document reproducible findings and remediation advice.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Expert
jobs.description: Part-time remote cybersecurity engagement assessing security risks, testing client applications and networks, investigating incidents and improving security controls and documentation.
responsibilities: Perform authorized vulnerability assessments and penetration tests.
Support incident monitoring, security controls and secure architecture reviews.
Create reports, security documentation and practical team guidance.
requirements: Practical knowledge of cybersecurity, network security, web application assessments and incident response.
Ability to operate independently in a remote part-time capacity.
Familiarity with SIEM, threat modeling and common security testing tools.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Analyst, GRC
jobs.description: Lead enterprise GRC, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance, automated evidence collection, risk assessment, vendor risk management and engineering-aligned security controls. Hybrid position in Dhaka.
responsibilities: Lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, assurance and remediation tracking.
Automate compliance evidence, monitoring and vendor security assessment workflows.
Partner with engineering, product and executives on technical risks and implementable controls.
requirements: Five or more years of experience in GRC or a related security discipline.
Experience with AWS, SaaS environments and technical implementation of SOC 2/ISO 27001 controls.
Hands-on scripting or infrastructure-as-code and risk-assessment methods.

jobs.title: Engineer, Cyber Defense Operations
jobs.description: Monitor security telemetry and investigate suspicious activity within bKash's cyber defense operation, escalating validated incidents and supporting monitoring improvements.
responsibilities: Triage security alerts and logs from SIEM, SOAR, EDR, PAM and related tools.
Investigate phishing, malware, unauthorized access, and suspicious indicators.
Maintain incident records and escalate cases through established procedures.
requirements: Degree in CSE, EEE, ECE, information security or a related discipline.
One to two years of relevant SOC or cybersecurity operations experience; fresh graduates may also apply.
Working understanding of networking, operating systems and log analysis.
CEH, CCNA, Security+, CySA+ or related credentials are an advantage.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description: Own the bank's information security management system and lead the enterprise security program, risk oversight, response planning and executive reporting.
responsibilities: Lead risk management and continuously improve security policies and frameworks.
Oversee incident management, threat monitoring dashboards and security awareness.
Report security posture and material risks to local leadership and Group CISO.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in information security, IT or a related field.
At least seven years in information security or related disciplines.
At least three years in a security leadership or supervisory capacity.
CISSP, CISM or similar certification is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer
jobs.description: Security engineering position covering web, mobile, API and fintech platforms, cloud environments and secure delivery practices.
responsibilities: Conduct application and API penetration tests and architecture reviews.
Review cloud access controls, platform hardening and security logging.
Integrate automated code and application security scanning into CI/CD.
Guide remediation across engineering and DevOps teams.
requirements: Five to eight years of cybersecurity experience, including at least three years in engineering or application security.
Practical experience with web/API testing, IAM, OAuth2, JWT, and OWASP frameworks.
Hands-on familiarity with Burp Suite, ZAP, Nessus, Nmap and DevSecOps tooling.
Financial-sector and relevant certifications are advantageous.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Expert — AI Security Evaluation
jobs.description: Short-term remote contract for cybersecurity specialists to design and evaluate realistic AI security and software vulnerability scenarios.
responsibilities: Create controlled multi-vulnerability test environments for AI evaluation.
Develop code-based security tasks, reproducible test cases and analysis reports.
Evaluate model outputs against diverse vulnerability classes.
requirements: At least four years of cybersecurity, application security or vulnerability research experience.
Strong knowledge of offensive testing and secure coding, including web/API weaknesses.
Comfortable with Python, Go, Node.js or Rust, containers and automated tests.
Bangladesh candidates are eligible; PST overlap is required.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst, ABG Sports City
jobs.description: Help operate information security controls, monitor incidents, assess vulnerabilities and support compliance across the organization's systems.
responsibilities: Monitor firewalls, endpoints and logs, and investigate security alerts.
Maintain baseline security policies, vulnerability tracking and access reviews.
Participate in incident response, awareness training and vendor assessments.
requirements: Degree in computer science or a related field.
Two to three years of IT experience with security exposure.
Familiarity with firewall/IDS tools, SIEM, vulnerability scanners and operating-system hardening.
Security+, CySA+, CEH or ISO 27001 credentials are preferred.

jobs.title: Network & Security Engineer (Sr. Executive / Officer)
jobs.description: Manage FortiGate firewalls and multivendor network infrastructure, resolve escalations and strengthen network defense.
responsibilities: Administer firewalls, VPN, IPS/IDS and SD-WAN configurations.
Troubleshoot routing, switching and network availability issues.
Maintain hardening, vulnerability checks and security documentation.
requirements: Degree in computing, telecom or comparable practical experience.
Three to six years in network/security engineering; detailed requirements call for strong Fortinet experience.
Fortinet certifications and enterprise networking experience are emphasized.

jobs.title: Advisor, Information Security
jobs.description: Information security advisory and security-operations position at Gildan in Dhaka, requiring several years of professional experience.
responsibilities: Support operational security initiatives and advise on security controls.
Participate in incident identification, monitoring and security reporting.
requirements: BSc in computer science or related qualification.
At least four years of experience across IT or information security-related roles.
Understanding of cyber threats and security controls.

jobs.title: Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Technical security engineer responsible for enterprise endpoint, SaaS and cloud security platforms across a distributed workforce.
responsibilities: Manage and optimize EDR, secure web gateway, CASB and zero-trust controls.
Define DLP rules across devices, SaaS and cloud platforms.
Improve endpoint vulnerability and SaaS posture management.
requirements: Five or more years of cybersecurity experience.
Hands-on background in EDR, DLP, SWG/CASB, ZTNA and vulnerability tools.
Comfortable with recognized frameworks and cloud security services.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Security Engineer
jobs.description: Focus on AWS and infrastructure security hardening, vulnerability validation and integration of security controls into modern production delivery.
responsibilities: Assess AWS identities, VPCs, servers and production infrastructure.
Integrate scanning and IaC controls with DevOps processes.
Investigate alerts and incidents, and track remediation to closure.
requirements: Five to eight years of security engineering experience.
Practical knowledge of AWS security capabilities, Linux hardening and infrastructure vulnerability testing.
Working understanding of CI/CD security and industry compliance frameworks.
